instrument: City of Wixom zoning ordinance amendment, August 26 2026
summary: Council adopted data center restrictions including a 1,500-foot setback from residential areas, parks and K-12 schools, plus sound study and water use requirements, effective no later than September 6, 2026, ending the six-month moratorium early.
notes: Adopted while the federal complaint was pending. Mayor Patrick Beagle is quoted stating that defensibility of the restrictions against the lawsuit was a consideration in finalizing the ordinance. Approximately 100 people are reported to have attended the meeting. The 1,500-foot setback is the largest identified in this corpus; the next largest is 400 feet.
confidence_note: Ordinance text not read. Whether the setback applies to buildings only or also to mechanical equipment and generators is NOT_CHECKED, and that distinction materially changes its effect.
